text: {"label":"Professional Roles of Behavior Analysts","definition":"Work on who behavior analysts are and what they do: professional development and identity, collaboration with other professions, roles in healthcare and public policy, advocacy, writing, and dissemination beyond the field.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on behavior analysts' broad professional identity, collaboration and advocacy, rather than credentialing and licensure, academic training programs and curricula, or qualitative research methods."}
